summary.headline: Ganesh Housing Q1 FY27 revenue rose 86% YoY to Rs 280 crore on One 91 Thaltej land sale, but PAT fell to Rs 42 crore on one-time tax; FY27 guided at Rs 1,000-1,200 crore revenue.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 revenue was Rs 280 crore, up 130% QoQ and 86% YoY, driven largely by the One 91 Thaltej land sale plus some completed old-project inventory. EBITDA was Rs 110 crore and PBT about Rs 105 crore, while PAT was Rs 42 crore because the land carried a higher tax cost from a 2020 amalgamation. Management guided FY27 revenue of Rs 1,000-1,200 crore and PAT of Rs 300-325 crore, with Million Minds lease rentals starting in Q4 FY27. Management said the Thaltej sale was a capital-allocation choice rather than a liquidity need, but did not disclose buyer, consideration or margin details.

financial_highlights.change: Lower QoQ and YoY due to one-time tax on Thaltej land sale
Management said up about 10% or roughly flat

segments.name: One 91 Thaltej (land monetisation)
segments.commentary: Land sold during Q1 rather than developed; management called it a project sale and said the transaction is complete. Consideration and buyer (a listed entity) were not disclosed; management indicated the Rs 500-600 crore land component of FY27 revenue includes Thaltej and Godhavi.

segments.name: Malabar Retreat (residential)
segments.commentary: Construction about 83% complete; 73 units booked, about 45% of units and Rs 183 crore, about 45% of sale value. Sale value above Rs 450 crore; no revenue recognised yet in Q1 as project is incomplete.

segments.name: Million Minds (commercial leasing)
segments.commentary: Phase-I inaugurated; fit-out in final stages. LOIs executed for about 43% (2.64 lakh sq ft) of leasable area, with a further 15-20% under negotiation; lease rentals to start in Q4 FY27. Management said FY28 rentals could exceed Rs 75 crore.

segments.name: Godhavi land (411 acres)
segments.commentary: Planned as a township mixing development, plotted development and land sales; possible monetisation towards later part of FY27, with details not yet worked out.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guided at Rs 1,000-1,200 crore and PAT at Rs 300-325 crore; management said PAT could rise about 10% or be flat given the Q1 one-time tax.
Million Minds lease rentals to start in Q4 FY27; full-year rentals expected in FY28.
Million Minds Phase-II launch expected in Q3 FY27; Million Minds residential Phase-I launch expected in Q4 FY27.
Management expects most FY27 revenue to be realised in cash within the year, with cash flows of about Rs 700-1,000 crore cited; GDV and cash-flow disclosure may be added going forward.
FY28 guidance not given; management indicated it may update in Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28.
capex_capacity: Land bank of about 510 acres fully paid, including 411 acres at Godhavi and 65 acres at Million Minds.
Million Minds long-term development potential of about 15 million sq ft (stated as 15 billion sq ft in the call; likely a transcription error).
Million Minds Phase-I built entirely from internal accruals; management said Thaltej monetisation adds cash for land purchases and Million Minds.
Million Minds Phase-II and residential Phase-I launches are scheduled for Q3 and Q4 FY27 respectively.
Several new land acquisitions are under discussion and not in the current land bank.
demand_pricing: Million Minds demand is coming from GCCs, technology companies and managed co-working operators; only SEZ portions remain to be leased, with full leasing expected in two to three months.
Malabar Retreat booking pace is about 45% of units and value, indicating healthy premium residential demand in Ahmedabad.

Margin compression on Thaltej was attributed to a higher land cost base from the 2020 amalgamation rather than to pricing; management said quarterly margins should be viewed in the context of project life cycle and IndAS 115 revenue recognition.
Management said the Thaltej land sale was worth more on a present-value basis than developing a commercial building over about five years (three years construction plus two years sales).

qa_highlights.question: Has the Thaltej land sale been completed, and is the full payment realised?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the sale is complete and Q1 numbers include it, but declined to disclose consideration, rate or payment status until the listed buyer is ready to disclose.

qa_highlights.question: How much of FY27 revenue of Rs 1,000-1,200 crore is land sale versus project revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it would classify most revenue as project sales. Excluding those, it cited about Rs 550-600 crore from land and about Rs 470 crore from projects, including the Rs 700 crore of project sales from Malabar Retreat and completed projects.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the Thaltej land sold and why did margins fall to about 39%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the sale was a present-versus-future value decision rather than a liquidity need. Margins were lower because the land cost from the amalgamation was higher, and the one-time tax was elevated by the same cost basis.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company disclose GDV and cash flows?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will reflect cash flows and GDV going forward, with cash flows being the more important metric; an offline discussion was offered for the FY27 numbers.

qa_highlights.question: What is the plan for Godhavi and Smile City?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said monetisation could come towards the later part of FY27, but details are not worked out given fluid developments in the area.

qa_highlights.question: What is the plan for the cash generated from the sale?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the cash will fund land purchases in Ahmedabad and Million Minds development, which is being funded from internal accruals.

risks_watch: Thaltej sale consideration, buyer and margin remain undisclosed; a later disclosure is expected.
Million Minds rentals depend on closing the remaining 15-20% of leasable area under negotiation and on starting rentals in Q4 FY27.
FY27 PAT guidance (Rs 300-325 crore) relies on a large Q2-Q4 contribution after a Rs 42 crore Q1 PAT.
Revenue recognition for Malabar Retreat depends on construction completion, and the project is about 83% complete.
Godhavi monetisation timing and plans are still open.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term strategy and Million Minds leasing, but guarded on specifics: management repeatedly declined to disclose Thaltej sale value and buyer details and deferred FY28 guidance. Tone was defensive on the margin and tax questions, attributing them to a one-time amalgamation tax effect.
key_quotes: We got a compelling offer to sell this land rather than developing it and taking the risk of both construction and sale of this multi-storied building over the next five years.

Monetization land under favorable market conditions enables us to accelerate cash generation, strengthen liquidity, and redeploy capital into opportunities that can deliver superior long-term returns.
Approvals and all were not the issue. Project by itself was not the issue, it was purely the present versus future possibilities that led to deciding that we should sell.
Yes, we are hopeful that Godhavi land and also developments therein should be there towards the later part of this year.

adds.what: Million Minds Phase-I commercial leasing (inaugurated; fit-out in final stages)

growth.why: FY27 revenue guided at Rs 1,000-1,200 crore (PAT Rs 300-325 crore), with Rs 500-600 crore land component from Thaltej and Godhavi; Malabar Retreat 45% booked (Rs 183 crore) and Million Minds LOIs cover 43% of leasable area (2.64 lakh sq ft), but Godhavi monetisation details are not yet worked out and Thaltej buyer/consideration undisclosed, so backing is partial.
